tooltip.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_ar.en: Doesn't lose durability while you wear it
- Magic damage from other creatures is reduced by %s
tooltip.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_ar.zh: - 别的生物打来的魔法伤害少受 %s

tooltip.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_ar.en: - Damage from bosses is reduced by %s
- Harmful effects on you last about %s shorter (Edict)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_ar.zh: - 身上的有害效果时长缩短约 %s（律令）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_ar.en: - A creature that lands a hit on you is convicted for %s seconds (up to %s at once); you deal %s more damage to it
tooltip.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_ar.zh: - 打实你的生物被定罪 %s 秒（同时最多 %s 个），你打它多 %s 伤害

tooltip.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_ar.en: - A creature that lands a hit on you is convicted for %s seconds (up to %s at once)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_ar.zh: - 打实你的生物被定罪 %s 秒（同时最多 %s 个）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.inqui.en: With all four pieces at stage 1, magic damage from other creatures is reduced by 45%; killing a creature you convicted with your own hand clears one harmful effect from you (Absolution, once every 10 seconds)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.inqui.zh: 四件都到 1 阶时，别的生物打来的魔法伤害少受 45%；亲手打死被你定罪的生物，清掉自己一个有害效果（赦罪，10 秒一次）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.inqui.en: With all four pieces at stage 2, you deal 30% more damage to convicted targets, 40% if the target is a boss
tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.inqui.zh: 四件都到 2 阶时，打被定罪的目标多 30% 伤害，目标是首领时多 40%

tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.inqui.en: With all four pieces at stage 3, the part of a single hit from a creature above 30% of your max health (after armor) is halved (Bulwark)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.inqui.zh: 四件都到 3 阶时，生物打来的一下在护甲之后超过最大生命 30% 的部分只受一半（壁垒）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.inqui.en: With all four pieces at stage 4, armor-piercing damage from creatures that isn't magic is reduced by 30%; Bulwark starts at 25% of your max health and you take 40% of the part above it
tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.inqui.zh: 四件都到 4 阶时，生物打来的无视护甲伤害（不是魔法的）少受 30%；壁垒从最大生命的 25% 起算，超出部分只受四成
